title: A Postcard to Future Me
description: For ages 6–9 with an adult: write and decorate a postcard to yourself, to be opened in one year.

body.heading: Write to the future
paragraphs: On your card, write a message to yourself in one year's time. Tell future-you what you love doing now, your favourite food, and your best friend.
Ask future-you some questions: Can you swim yet? Did the tooth fall out? Is your hair longer?

body.heading: Draw today's world
paragraphs: Draw a picture of yourself today — your height, your hairstyle, your favourite jumper. Add the date in big numbers.
Future-you will laugh at how much has changed. That is the magic of the postcard: it freezes today still.

body.heading: Seal and hide
paragraphs: Put the card in its envelope and write DO NOT OPEN UNTIL next to next year's date. Ask your adult to keep it somewhere safe.
One year from now, opening it will feel like getting a letter from a friendly stranger who knows you very well.

takeaway: A postcard to your future self freezes today in words and pictures, ready to surprise you in a year.
safetyNotes: An adult keeps the postcard somewhere safe. Write only things you are happy for your family to read.
screenFreeExtension: Write a second postcard for a friend and swap — each of you keeps the other's safe for a year.
